validity.recommendation: Keep LengthKnownKm = 399.90 as-is — do not change it, and do not let the 561 km schematic draw (ratio 1.40) push a 'fix' toward a longer number. I obtained the Ukrtransgaz historical-development chronology via Wayback (utg.ua 403s live per gotcha 1; the exact document the source_ladder flagged as the one that would close cluster A). It documents the dedicated «Kyїv – Zakhidnyi kordon Ukrayiny» pipeline as two strings: 1970, I nitka, 183.6 km, ∅1020mm; and 1972, II nitka, 216.3 km, ∅1220mm. 183.6 + 216.3 = 399.9 km — an exact match to two decimal places against P1480's stated 399.90, and against the row's own Diameter cell ('1020, 1220') which lists both strings' diameters together. This is a strong, independent, primary-source corroboration (the operator's own construction record), not a coincidence. The 561 km schematic draw (ratio 1.40) sits just outside the 0.6–1.4 tolerance band, but P1480 is NOT one of the two rows the protocol names as genuine exceeding-length exceptions (P0784, P1481) — a 2–5 vertex schematic slightly overshooting via an extra bend/vertex is far more consistent with ordinary schematic noise than with a real length error, especially set against a documentary match this precise. Recommend closing this length_ratio flag as explained, not defect.
validity.researcher_notes: Searched: Ukrtransgaz historical chronology (utg.ua, via Wayback) — found both dedicated KZU string entries with lengths and diameters; summed to 399.9 km, matching the sheet exactly. Also confirms (consistent with the already-staged cluster A finding, not re-derived here) that Drozdovychi belongs to the separate, older 1966-vintage Komarno–Drozdovychi corridor, not to the 1970s KZU build — the chronology's 1966 entries list 'Дроздовичі – Держкордон СРСР' (1.3 km) and 'Дроздовичі – Хідновичі' (6.6 km) years before the KZU strings, so P1480's Drozdovychi endpoint anachronism (already staged) is corroborated by this same source, not contradicted.
